units.source_text: 这天傍晚，列席的小野田六段和八幡干事也都到对星馆来了。

en.t: That evening, Onoda 6-dan and Secretary Yahata, who were attending, also came together to the Taiseikan.

units.source_text: 名人挑战，玩起将棋和连珠棋，很是热闹。

en.t: The Master accepted the challenge and began playing shogi and renju, making the scene quite lively.

units.source_text: 名人下连珠棋，又名朝鲜五子棋，连续败给小野田六段。

en.t: The Master played renju, also known as Korean five-in-a-row, and lost several games in succession to Onoda 6-dan.
